nodes.label: E-Commerce Platform
nodes.description: Full-stack web application with Python/FastAPI backend, React/Vite frontend, and PostgreSQL database.

nodes.label: Layered Architecture
nodes.description: Backend follows modular layered architecture: API -> Router -> Service -> Repository -> Database.

nodes.label: REST API
nodes.description: API style using REST architecture with resources represented as nouns and standard HTTP methods.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.description: Token-based authentication using JWT access tokens (30 min) and refresh tokens (7 days) via python-jose.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control
nodes.description: Permission system using roles (admin, user) with separate dependencies for user and admin access.

nodes.label: UUID Primary Keys
nodes.description: All database tables use UUID primary keys for better security and distributed system support.

nodes.label: Paginated API
nodes.description: Large lists use pagination with page, limit, and total fields in response.

nodes.label: Component-Based Architecture
nodes.description: Frontend divided into pages, components, layouts, hooks, services, utilities, assets, and state management.

nodes.label: Input Validation
nodes.description: Every external input must be validated including request bodies, query parameters, file uploads, user data.

nodes.label: Multi-Warehouse Inventory
nodes.description: Multi-warehouse inventory tracking with per-product stock levels across warehouses and inter-warehouse transfers.

nodes.label: Guest Checkout
nodes.description: Checkout flow supporting guest users without requiring authentication.

nodes.label: No Business Logic in Routers
nodes.description: Routers must NOT contain business logic; logic belongs in services.

nodes.label: No Direct Database Access
nodes.description: API endpoints must never directly access database; must go through Repository layer.

nodes.label: Single File Models
nodes.description: All SQLAlchemy models are in a single database_models.py file (~1400 lines).

nodes.label: Single File Schemas
nodes.description: All Pydantic schemas are in a single request_response_models.py file (~1800 lines).

nodes.label: UUID Primary Keys Rule
nodes.description: All tables use UUID primary keys for security and distributed system support.

nodes.label: UTC Timestamps
nodes.description: All timestamps use UTC (timezone=True) for consistency.

nodes.label: No Raw Passwords
nodes.description: Never store plain passwords; always use secure hashing (bcrypt/Argon2).

nodes.label: Validate All Input
nodes.description: Every external input must be validated; never trust client input.

nodes.label: Pydantic Schemas Required
nodes.description: Every API endpoint must have request and response schemas; never return SQLAlchemy models directly.

nodes.label: Consistent Response Format
nodes.description: All responses follow {success, message, data} format; errors follow {success, message, error_code}.

nodes.label: Component-Service-API Separation
nodes.description: API calls must be separated from UI components; Component -> Service -> API pattern.

nodes.label: Table Plural snake_case
nodes.description: Table names must be plural, lowercase, snake_case (e.g., users, products, order_items).

nodes.label: Column snake_case
nodes.description: All columns must use lowercase snake_case (e.g., first_name, created_at).

nodes.label: Foreign Keys Required
nodes.description: Always use foreign keys for relationships to protect data integrity.

nodes.label: Migrations Required
nodes.description: Every database structure change must use Alembic migrations; never manually modify production databases.

nodes.label: PEP 8 Python
nodes.description: Python backend code must follow PEP 8 style with type hints and proper formatting.

nodes.label: Small Functions
nodes.description: Functions should do one thing, have clear names, be small, and avoid too many parameters.

nodes.label: No Duplicate Code
nodes.description: Before writing new code, search existing code; reuse or refactor, do not copy-paste.
